Container.Name: sanctum
Container.Overview: A locked-by-default vault that ingests, verifies and keeps encrypted Tryst backups on your server. The key is never stored: after every start you unlock it in the web UI. Keep this on your LAN only; never forward the port to the internet.
Container.Requires: The vault folder must be writable by uid 65532; the inbox needs read access only. Do not publish the port outside your LAN.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: LAN only. Never forward this port to the internet.

Config.Name: Inbox
Config.Description: Drop folder for incoming .tryst backups (Syncthing, SMB, etc). Read-only to Sanctum; treat as untrusted input.

Config.Name: Vault
Config.Description: Encrypted backups and the sealed index. Only ciphertext is ever written here.

Config.Name: Notification URL
Config.Description: Where Sanctum sends alerts (locked too long, stale backup, failed verify). Paste ONE URL: ntfy://host/topic, ntfy+http://lan-host:port/topic, a Discord or Slack webhook, or any webhook. It is a credential, so it is masked. Test: docker exec sanctum /usr/local/bin/sanctum -notify-test

Config.Name: Stale after (days)
Config.Description: Alert when an owner's newest backup is older than this.

Config.Name: Check for new releases
Config.Description: true = once a day ask GitHub's public releases API whether a newer Sanctum exists, and notify. Reports only; GitHub sees your IP. Updating is still done from the Docker tab.

Config.Name: Locked alert after (hours)
Config.Description: Alert if the vault stays locked this long. 0 disables.
